primary_endpoint.endpoint: Target-tissue AUC (brain-adjacent tissue drug concentration × time)

secondary_endpoints.measurement: AUC_tissue / AUC_CSF — measures drug distribution efficiency
Hours where tissue concentration ≥ therapeutic threshold
Hours where CSF concentration ≥ therapeutic threshold
Venous blood drug concentration — measures systemic loss
Continuous flow measurement — must be ≥ 0.3 mL/min
Continuous ICP monitoring — must be < 20 mmHg
Peak tissue concentration — must reach therapeutic threshold for clinically meaningful result

acceptance_criteria.therapeutic: Tissue Cmax ≥ therapeutic threshold for at least one timepoint
acceptance_criteria.pk_proxy_acknowledgment: If tissue Cmax does not reach therapeutic threshold, the result is a PK proxy (relative exposure improvement), not therapeutic benefit

design.drug: FITC-dextran 150 kDa (fluorescent surrogate, matches bevacizumab MW)
design.sampling: CSF: 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 24, 48h; Tissue: post-mortem; Venous: same as CSF; ICP: continuous

decision_tree.AUC ≥ 120% BUT Cmax < therapeutic: PK PROXY CONFIRMED — relative exposure improvement; clinical benefit requires higher dose or different agent
